description: The ordered seed steps for a local database. Each script names a package.json script. db:reset and db:fast-reset both run this whole list through scripts/lib/seed-steps.mjs; the e2e global-setup fallback runs the entries marked minimal. scripts/check-seed-steps.mjs fails if package.json, the CI setup action, or global-setup drift from it. Add a new seed here, not in those places.

steps.note: supabase/seed.sql: the base rows every other seed builds on.
Creates the auth users and user_profiles. Idempotent over an auth.users that survives a fast-reset (PP-3vdr.6).
machines is truncated CASCADE, which clears collections. Omitting this left collections empty after every fast-reset (PP-tn6t).
machines CASCADE clears machine_tags, so the memberships need reseeding. The seed replaces its own types and tags.
machines CASCADE clears machine_settings_sets. Omitting this left it empty after every fast-reset (PP-tn6t).
Idempotent NOT-EXISTS backfill of timeline events.

Not truncated by fast-reset, but an E2E-only database never runs db:reset, so without this step the mirror stays empty and the model picker searches nothing with no error (PP-o355.21). An idempotent upsert, so re-running only refreshes.
Same never-seeded reason as the catalog: the OPDB copy is not truncated but E2E-only databases would otherwise get no rows (PP-wqit.12).
Reached by the fast-reset TRUNCATE (the state seed writes machine link columns, and machines CASCADE clears them) as well as the never-seeded case (PP-tn6t).
